coordinator_note: Every theoretical value read against its quotes. Holmes: Theorems 1 and 2 lose their inequality signs in the text layer, so their bounds are not quoted and they are LOW; the zero-mean gradient result and the stated scope (no meaningful lower bound) stay HIGH. Hu 2022: the Theorem 1 bound and tolerance symbol are lost, and Lemma 1's operator is not quoted. Hu 2024: the replica method with replica symmetry is a non-rigorous approximation, so every result is LOW; Appendix E prints the phase-transition condition reversed. Huang 2021 (information-theoretic bounds) and Huang 2021 (power of data): the text layer drops epsilon and square-root signs; every result whose quoted statement lost one of them is LOW, while results quoted intact (the Holevo query bound, Lemmas 6, 8 and 9, the quantum lower bound, the Bell-basis idea, Proposition 1 on BPP=BQP, Proposition 3, the Appendix I example and the discrete-log result) stay HIGH. Exponents printed flat are not counted as lost symbols
